description: Patch-level bumps of Apache NiFi Registry automerge here: the Molecule run creates a bucket through the API, asserts that the process reports the version defaults/main.yml pins, and fails if files/conf/ stops matching that image - which is the by-hand reconciliation docs/updating-nifi-registry.md describes, turned into a gate.
A patch release that does change a shipped configuration file therefore fails CI instead of merging. Minor and major bumps stay human-reviewed pull requests.
